description_en: Puts an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance into the Standby state
description_zh: 将伸缩组内的ECS实例设置为备用状态
kebab_example: aliyun ess enter-standby --scaling-group-id asg-bp1fo0dbtsbmqa9h0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --instance-ids i-28wt40000 --async false --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnterStandby

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to asynchronously put the ECS instance into the Standby state. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否采用异步任务方式执行。取值范围：

- true：异步任务执行。
- false：同步执行。

默认值： false
parameters.name: async
